name: modernize-code-behind-monolith
prompt: Restructure an existing WPF application where database calls, business rules, and device commands are implemented directly in window code-behind. Minimize risk and avoid a big-bang rewrite.
rubric: Introduces seams around risky external operations before moving UI code.
Moves business and infrastructure behavior incrementally with behavior-preserving tests.
Does not require rewriting all views or adopting abstractions without a concrete boundary.
